title: Accept only kinds that do an interface
objective: Use some type that does an interface, so the function accepts only kinds that provide the interface's methods.

body.text: A generic function often needs its value to have a certain method. Write that interface first, as in the interfaces lesson. Then write some type that does the interface in the parameter. Only kinds that do the interface can be passed to the function, so the function can safely call the method.

body.title: A function for anything that prints
body.code:
interface printable
    can print
        say "checked"

class card does printable
    has rank of type number

function print value
    takes anything that does printable called value
    print of value

make v equal to a new card with rank 7
print value of v

body.prompt: The card satisfies the printable interface, but nothing in the program ever prints. Make it print printed.
body.starter:
